source_context.paper: Mayershofer, Holm, Molter, Fottner, LOCO: Logistics Objects in Context, ICMLA 2020

confirmed_facts.fact: LOCO lists small_load_carrier as one of five annotated detection classes.
The pinned annotations label sub1 and sub4 as val, and sub2, sub3, and sub5 as train.
The official README states 5 logistics environments; the paper documents five subsets and a non-random subset-based benchmark split.
LOCO says images were captured while walking through a logistics setting using low-cost cameras.

inferences.claim: crate_blue_a02 may serve as a narrow synthetic visual proxy for small_load_carrier because its measured deep, approximately 0.6 x 0.4 m crate silhouette is more plausible than the shallow baseline.
inferences.basis: The official class is a broad detection category and the paper notes object variation inside classes; the USD measurement is project-local geometry evidence.

inferences.claim: The proposed train=sub2/sub5, tuning=sub3/sub4, heldout=sub1 split is a support-aware auxiliary experiment split, not the full original LOCO benchmark.
inferences.basis: The pinned source filenames use train for sub2/3/5 and val for sub1/4.

inferences.claim: The existing same-file, pixel-SHA, and pHash<=6 zero findings support only the stated image-level duplicate checks.
inferences.basis: docs/evidence/loco-rgb-249.json reports no cross-role candidates for those three checks.

unverified: A formal LOCO definition tying small_load_carrier to KLT, Euro-container, ESD properties, a size range, color, material, or perforation pattern.
crate_blue_a02 equivalence to any real LOCO carrier or any KLT/ESD standard.
An official recording_id, frame order/timestamp, or sequence-level split contract.
An official subset-to-physical-environment map and proof that environments do not cross proposed roles.

applicable_decisions.asset_mapping: Keep nvidia:crate_blue_a02 as candidate_pending_shape_and_domain_validation; preserve mapping_approved=false and training_ready=false.
applicable_decisions.naming: Use synthetic small-load-carrier visual proxy candidate; do not claim KLT, Euro-container, ESD-safe, or LOCO physical equivalence.
applicable_decisions.split: Call sub1 a fixed auxiliary heldout candidate drawn from an upstream val partition, not an official LOCO test set.
applicable_decisions.independence: Report image duplicate checks only. Do not report sequence-disjoint or environment-disjoint evaluation until the three required metadata fields support a group-level audit.
